title: TectoTrack - Social Digital Twin
subtitle: AI-powered agent-based modeling for urban behavior simulation

blocks.title: Project Overview
blocks.subtitle: Revolutionizing urban design through digital twin technology
blocks.content: TectoTrack is an advanced Social Digital Twin platform that simulates human behavior patterns and analyzes social interactions in built environments. The system uses AI-powered agent-based modeling with distinct human behavior profiles to optimize public spaces, retail layouts, and wayfinding systems through predictive crowd dynamics analytics.

images.caption: Main simulation interface showing urban environment
Different agent behavior profiles in action

blocks.title: Technical Implementation
blocks.content: The system was built using Python for the core simulation engine, integrated with Rhino and Grasshopper for spatial analysis. We implemented machine learning algorithms to train agent behaviors based on real-world observational data, creating a robust predictive model that can simulate various urban scenarios with high accuracy.
